source: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) Program
description: Toxic chemical releases reported by industrial facilities under Section 313 of the Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act (EPCRA)
update_frequency: Annual (facilities report by July 1 each year)
disclaimer: TRI data reflects self-reported releases from facilities meeting reporting thresholds (10+ employees AND manufacturing/processing/using listed chemicals above threshold quantities). Smaller facilities and non-listed chemicals are not included. Absence of a facility does not mean no toxic releases occur nearby. Release quantities are estimates, not measurements. This tool is informational and is not a health risk assessment.
